svg.title: All 72 targeted pack-once cases compared with NumPy
svg.desc: A heatmap of NumPy time divided by solvcon time for two dtypes, three broadcast positions, two unsupported inner layouts, and six affected matrix sizes. Every ratio is above one. The weakest is 1.11, the median is 1.64, and the strongest is 2.97.
svg.text: All 72 targeted pack-once cases beat NumPy
Each cell is NumPy time / solvcon time. Above 1.00 means solvcon is faster.
PR #1256 · native macOS arm64 · NumPy 2.5.1 · Accelerate · 1 BLAS thread
2 dtypes × 3 broadcast positions × 2 inner layouts × 6 affected sizes = 72 Cartesian cases
Targeted family on one machine; this is not a cross-platform matmul ranking. Orange outline marks the weakest result.
